Scope: Static publisher-page, version, licensing and sensitive-data review of MiTeC Windows Registry Recovery and SMBIOS Explorer; no payload executed and no host hive, WMI or firmware data read

TermsPage.Observation: MiTeC's current support EULA says unregistered/trial applications are freeware for non-commercial use and lists separate license types. Product-page terms, local entitlement and distribution rights remain distinct.

Products.Name: MiTeC Windows Registry Recovery
Products.PublishedBehavior: Reads Windows registry hive files and exports REGEDIT4. The page lists hive views for file metadata/checksums, security records, SAM machine SID/part of SYSKEY/local users/groups, Windows product/name/ID/key and installed software, user Start menu, hardware/device maps, startup entries, services/drivers, network configuration, firewall rules, environment, shell folders, Outlook Express account settings and raw registry data. It also has a Registry Backup tool in version history.
Products.LicensePagePriceObservation: The page lists EUR 30 single-user and EUR 150 site lifetime licenses on the review date; local entitlement and distribution are unresolved.
Products.Acceptance: Use only synthetic offline hive fixtures. Do not open host/guest real hives or export keys/reports containing product keys, SYSKEY material, SIDs, accounts, network/firewall settings, Outlook Express configuration or other personal/system data. If testing backup/export, constrain output to a disposable folder and verify exact cleanup.

Products.Name: MiTeC SMBIOS Explorer
Products.PublishedBehavior: Reads SMBIOS through registry, WMI, ROM memory or API, displays hex/decoded data and system summary, searches files for SMBIOS tables, and saves plain/compressed captures. Its identification overview collects serial and asset numbers; the version history says system serial and UUID were added to the overview. SMBIOS helper SMBIOS.exe is a separate x86 1.0.0.0 executable, not the main application version.
Products.LicensePageObservation: The page offers a 14-day trial, says its unregistered version permits basic hex/interpreter/search plus save/load after expiration, and lists a EUR 30 lifetime single-user license. Local entitlement and redistribution remain unresolved.
Products.Acceptance: Use only a synthetic SMBIOS file/image and keep registry/WMI/ROM/API collection disabled. Do not query, capture, log, screenshot or export real serials, asset tags, UUIDs or firmware tables. Test only the decoder and file search using synthetic fixture data.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Current versions, x86/x64 variants and helper-version distinction, published hive/SMBIOS data sources and sensitive fields are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Local entitlements, exact output redaction/retention, live-data access behavior, registry backup effects, UI and activation remain unverified.
Deferred: Owner-specific application use and archive distribution assessment
No real registry hives, product keys, SYSKEY, accounts, network settings, Outlook settings, SMBIOS serials, asset tags or UUIDs in acceptance
Future checks limited to synthetic offline hives and synthetic SMBIOS files; verify output cleanup
Windows target, UI and activation behavior through an approved guest workflow
MigrationDisposition.EstimateReason: Sensitive data sources, export paths and distinct helper version are clearer, but rights and complete runtime/recovery outcomes remain open; no estimate deduction is justified.
